name: histra.net
description: Sends movie and episode playback events from Jellyfin to your histra.net account. Reports start / pause / progress / stop; sufficiently completed playback is automatically marked as watched. Two-way sync of watched state and playback progress via a scheduled task, plus real-time export on watched/unwatched changes.
overview: Scrobble playback to histra.net — media tracking like Trakt.

versions.changelog: Initial release: scrobbling, two-way watched & playback-progress sync, per-user tokens (config or manager).
